High_confidence_malignant_logic: Atypical epithelial-dominant, tumor-associated, normal-reference-depleted patient-specific CNV clone.
Tumor_hepatocyte_logic: Tumor-site mature-hepatocyte CNV clusters were compared with patient-matched normal hepatocytes when >=20 normal cells were available; otherwise pooled normal hepatocytes were used.
Conservative_policy: Cells with conflicting CNV/tissue/phenotype evidence were retained as Ambiguous rather than forced into a binary malignant/non-malignant classification.
Important_interpretation: Malignancy is inferred from scRNA-seq expression-derived CNV and transcriptional/contextual evidence, not directly measured by DNA sequencing.
